#<thinking>
Let me plan a lean standing dog (a Doberman-type) in canonical +Z-up orientation, built from surface patches.

**Coordinate system:**
- Z is up: the paws rest near z = -0.5, the back tops out near z ~ +0.4.
- Y is the body length: muzzle at the front (y ~ +0.78), tail at the back (y ~ -0.7).
- X is width, left-right symmetric about x = 0.

**Construction (each part has its own label sub-tree):**
- dog/body/... and dog/head/...  - the torso, neck and head are surface-patch strips that wrap around the form; neighbouring strips share their boundary rows/columns so the skin is one connected surface (control grids given directly).
- dog/leg/<front|back>_<left|right>  - the four legs reduce to simple geometry, so each is a straight tapered tube swept along a short centerline from the belly down to the paw, the radius shrinking toward the foot.
- dog/tail/tail  - one tapered tube swept from the rump to a point.
- dog/ear/right_*, dog/ear/left_*  - the dog is symmetric, so only the right ear is given; the left ear is its mirror across x = 0.

The body/head grids, the leg and tail centerlines/radii, the ear grids and the mirror step are below.

[run_python]

# the body skin reads as short fur: deeper (s=0.70) and finer (f=4); head/legs/tail/ears stay clean (f=1)
for label,s,nu,nv,pts in BODY: emit(label,0.70,np.array(pts,float).reshape(nu,nv,3),f=4)
for label,s,nu,nv,pts in HEAD: emit(label,s,np.array(pts,float).reshape(nu,nv,3))

# ===== a round tube swept along a centerline with a per-station radius (legs + tail) =====
def sweep_tube(centerline,radii,N=8):
    centerline=np.asarray(centerline,float);rings=[]
    for j,(c,r) in enumerate(zip(centerline,radii)):
        t=centerline[min(j+1,len(centerline)-1)]-centerline[max(j-1,0)];t=t/(np.linalg.norm(t)+1e-9)
        up=np.array([1.,0,0]) if abs(t[2])>0.9 else np.array([0.,0,1])
        n1=np.cross(t,up);n1=n1/(np.linalg.norm(n1)+1e-9);n2=np.cross(t,n1)
        ring=[c+r*(np.cos(a)*n1+np.sin(a)*n2) for a in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,N,endpoint=False)];ring.append(ring[0]);rings.append(ring)
    return np.array(rings)

# ===== LEGS: four straight tapered tubes from the belly to the paws =====
LEGS={
  "back_left": ([(-0.023,-0.233,0.012), (-0.047,-0.251,-0.080), (-0.062,-0.277,-0.171), (-0.078,-0.308,-0.263), (-0.095,-0.331,-0.356), (-0.107,-0.351,-0.449)], [0.047, 0.057, 0.046, 0.035, 0.022, 0.023]),

def mirror_x(g):
    m=np.asarray(g,float).copy();m[...,0]*=-1;return m[:,::-1,:]
for label,s,nu,nv,pts in EARS:

# write the complete <faces> block to final_output.txt — the system reads your final result from this file
with open("final_output.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"<faces>\n{len(patches)}\n")
    for label, s, ff, g in patches:
        g = np.asarray(g, float)
        f.write(f"# {label}  s={s:.2f} f={ff}\n{g.shape[0]} {g.shape[1]}\n")
        for x, y, z in g.reshape(-1, 3):
            f.write(f"{x:.3f} {y:.3f} {z:.3f}\n")
    f.write("</faces>\n")
